+# Mini Template
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.
+
+## Use as a library
+
+```ts
+import { render } from "./src/engine";
+
+render("Hello, {{user.name}}!", { user: { name: "Ada" } });
+```
+
+`{{path}}` HTML-escapes text, while `{{{path}}}` does not. It supports nested
+`#if` and `#each` blocks, optional `{{else}}` branches, comments, `{{this}}`,
+and `{{@index}}`. Normal paths inside loops resolve from the root data object.
+
+## CLI
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts TEMPLATE_FILE DATA.json
+```
+
+The command writes only rendered output to stdout. Errors are written to stderr
+and return a non-zero exit status.
+
+## Test
+
+```sh
+bun test
+```
